title: Perfect Group Activity
text:
Would definitely recommend as a group activity, perfect for a hen/stag, family event, or just as a group of friends. 

The instructor was great and patient, recognised that we had bad rhythm but still made it fun.
author: Malidav2193

title: Fun with Family
text: Ruth was amazing...she was a very patient instructor who took time with each of us as she taught us the choreography! A nice hour to do something different. Lots of laughter!!! Thank you.
author: ginaaK2002LX
